s-1.ptxt: Fuel Spill Prevention Procedure

item.ptxt: Perform the work with the engine coolant temperature at 60°C or less.
Before removing fuel system parts, be sure to perform the fuel spill prevention procedure.
Even after the fuel spill prevention procedure, some pressure remains in the fuel line, so when disconnecting the fuel line, cover it with a shop rag etc. to prevent fuel from spraying.

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear seat assembly LH.
(see )
Remove the rear floor service hole cover.
Disconnect the fuel pump connector from the fuel suction tube assembly.
Start the engine.
After the engine stops by itself, turn the IG OFF.

atten4.ptxt: Lean malfunction DTCs "P0171/25" and "P0174/25" may be detected.

s2.ptxt: Crank the engine again and check that it does not start.
Remove the fuel tank cap and release the pressure in the fuel tank.
Disconnect the cable from the negative (-) battery terminal.
(For the procedure, refer to )
Connect the fuel pump connector to the fuel suction tube assembly.
Install the rear floor service hole cover with new butyl tape.

s-1.ptxt: Drain Coolant (Toyota Genuine Super Long Life Coolant)

atten2.ptxt: To avoid the danger of being burned, do not remove the reservoir tank cap while the engine and radiator are still hot. Liquid and steam will spray out under pressure.

Remove the reserve tank cap and drain the coolant.
Loosen the cylinder block drain cock plug and drain the coolant from the engine.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Intake Air Surge Tank Assembly

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the vacuum hose from the throttle body assembly (*1).

Remove the 2 nuts from the intake air surge tank. (*3)

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Fuel Tube Sub-assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the fuel pipe clamp No.2.
Disconnect the fuel tube. (see )

item.ptxt: Before starting work, remove any mud or other foreign matter adhering to the fuel tube connector.
The fuel tube connector uses an O-ring to seal the fuel tube connector and pipe, so be very careful to prevent damage to and foreign matter on the connecting parts.
Always perform removal and installation by hand without using tools.
Do not forcibly bend, kink or twist the nylon tube.
If the fuel tube connector and pipe are stuck, push and pull to free them before pulling them apart.
After disconnecting the fuel pump tube, protect the connecting parts with a plastic bag or similar.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Fuel Delivery Pipe w/ Injector

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the 6 fuel injector assembly connectors.
Remove the 5 bolts, pull the fuel delivery pipe straight up, and remove the fuel delivery pipe w/ fuel injectors.
Remove the 6 insulators from the intake manifold.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Fuel Injector Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the 6 fuel injector assemblies from the fuel delivery pipe.

atten3.ptxt: If the injectors are to be reinstalled without replacement, write the cylinder number on a tag or similar and keep them separated.

s2.ptxt: Remove the O-ring from the fuel injector.
